sections.title: 1. General Information
sections.content: We treat your personal information confidentially and in accordance with legal data protection regulations. This policy explains what data we collect, how we use it, and what rights you have regarding your data.

sections.title: 2. Responsible Party for Data Processing
sections.content: The responsible party for data processing within this web app is: [Operator's Name] [Address] [Email Address] [Phone Number]

sections.title: 3. Collection and Storage of Personal Data
4. Use of Data for Wishlist Management
sections.content: Each wishlist belongs to exactly one person. It is private at first and visible only to the person it belongs to. Once it is shared, exactly the people who have been entered on it can see that list and the ideas on it. Those people may mark an idea as bought; they cannot add, change or delete entries. Product links and ideas are stored in our database.

sections.title: 5. Data Sharing and Transfer
sections.content: We share your personal data only when it is necessary to provide our service or when the law requires it. We pass data to third parties only with your explicit consent.

sections.title: 6. Data Retention and Deletion
sections.content: We keep your personal data only for as long as the purposes listed in this policy or the law require. In most cases we delete it after the contractual relationship has ended and the statutory retention periods have passed.

sections.title: 7. Your Rights
sections.content: You have the right at any time to ask what data we hold about you, to have incorrect data corrected, to have processing restricted, to have your data deleted where the law allows it, and to object to the processing of your data. Write to jsbase.dev@gmail.com to exercise these rights or if you have questions about how we process your personal data.

sections.title: 8. Data Security
sections.content: We use appropriate technical and organizational security measures to protect your data against unauthorized access, loss or manipulation.

sections.title: 9. Changes to this policy
sections.content: We may change this privacy policy when legal requirements or the way the app works change. The current version of the policy is always available in the app.

subsections.title: a) When Visiting Our Web App
subsections.content: When you open the app, our server automatically stores your IP address, the date and time of the visit, the browser and operating system you used, the pages you visited and the actions you took in the app. We use this data only to keep the app running smoothly and to improve it; it is deleted automatically afterwards.

subsections.title: b) Registration and Login for Using the Web App
subsections.content: To use the app you need an account with a nickname, an email address and a password; we derive the display name from the nickname. When you register we store your account data (nickname, email address, password and display name), your own wishlists with their gift ideas and product links, and on shared lists the email address and display name of the people the list is shared with. The password is hashed before it is stored and cannot be recovered as plain text. For every idea marked as bought we also store the account that marked it. Everyone the list is shared with sees the same mark and can correct each other's marks. The person who owns the list cannot take away a mark somebody else set. The name is never shown in the app.

sections.title: 1. Scope
sections.content: These Terms and Conditions apply to the use of the wishy web app, a platform for organizing gifts between individual people.

sections.title: 2. Service Description
sections.content: wishy helps you organize gift wishes, create wishlists and keep track of planned gifts. The app coordinates gifts between the people who share a list, and the surprise stays.

sections.title: 3. Registration and User Account
sections.content: Using wishy requires creating an account of your own with an email address and a password. Users are obligated to keep their access credentials confidential and protect them from third-party access.

sections.title: 4. Usage Rules
sections.content: Users agree to use the app only for its intended purpose and not to share any illegal or offensive content.

sections.title: 5. Privacy
sections.content: Details are in our privacy policy.

sections.title: 6. Disclaimer
sections.content: wishy does not guarantee constant availability of the app and is not liable for damages caused by slight negligence.
